subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery + security review — Aurora Cloud
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@auroracloud.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery + security review — Aurora Cloud

Thanks for the time today, Alex — great conversation. As discussed, I put together the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) items focused on the security review so we can keep the procurement/contract milestone on track. Please confirm these and flag any missing dependencies.

MAP (security milestone) — target close: 2026-10-15
- Redwood deliver SOC 2 package + completed questionnaire: due 2026-10-02 (owner: Marissa)
- Aurora review evidence list & confirm acceptance / open questions: due 2026-10-07 (owner: Alex / Security)
- Redwood provide sample logs and retention policy details: due 2026-10-05 (owner: Dylan)
- Procurement to confirm PO timing & contract route: due 2026-10-12 (owner: Aurora Procurement)

Dependencies: evidence acceptance by Aurora is required before Procurement can finalize payment terms; if Aurora requests additional evidence, we may need an extra 3 business days.

Next steps: I will send the SOC 2 package and questionnaire tomorrow morning (10/02). Please confirm the owners above and whether the 10/15 target close is realistic on your side.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@auroracloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@auroracloud.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery + security review — Aurora Cloud

Thanks Marissa — that plan looks sensible. A couple quick clarifications from our security team:
- For the sample logs, can you provide examples for both API request logs and infrastructure syslogs (redacted as needed)?
- On evidence, we typically require network diagrams + KMS key management docs; are those included in the SOC2 package or provided separately?

Procurement — looping you in so you can surface any internal timing constraints.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Security Engineer | Aurora Cloud
alex.johnson@auroracloud.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@auroracloud.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery + security review — Aurora Cloud

Per our commitment, attached is the SOC 2 package and the completed questionnaire. Contents (high level) are below — full files attached to this thread.

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_Package_v1.zip — includes: SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), network diagrams (PDF), KMS & key rotation policy (PDF), retention policy (DOCX)
- SOC2_Evidence_List.xlsx — spreadsheet of artifacts and where they live (links + owner)
- SOC2_Questionnaire_filled.pdf — completed questionnaire for Aurora to review

Action items we covered:
- Dylan will provide redacted samples of API request logs and syslogs by EOD 2026-10-05 (owner: Dylan)
- Marissa to follow up on evidence acceptance by 2026-10-07
- If Aurora requests additional artifacts, please list them in a single reply so we can triage quickly

If the package looks complete, we can lock the security milestone and have Procurement move to PO/contract next week.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Package_v1.zip; SOC2_Evidence_List.xlsx; SOC2_Questionnaire_filled.pdf

Hi Alex — quick note from the SE side. We will produce two redacted log samples: one API request log (one day sample) and one infrastructure syslog (anonymized hostnames). ETA: 2026-10-05 EOD.

Link to secure share (temporary): https://secure-share.redwood.com/log-samples/aurora-2026-10-02 (expires in 7 days).

Also noting: if you need raw logs vs. parsed events, call that out and we will deliver both formats.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Procurement <procurement@auroracloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@auroracloud.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T13:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery + security review — Aurora Cloud

Marissa / Alex — thanks for the package. Procurement will need a confirmation from your side on the following before we can route the PO: 
- Confirm that the SOC 2 evidence list includes IP allowlist and certificate rotation details (we standardize on a 90-day cert rotation window)
- Confirm whether Redwood supports an IP allowlist or VPN-based connectivity for webhook endpoints (we prefer allowlist + mTLS)

If those are included, we can issue the PO by 2026-10-12. If additional artifacts are required, please call them out today so we can avoid delays.

Thanks,
Aurora Procurement Team
procurement@auroracloud.com
